Admin Shop Tab Subtitle: Trade your resources for Blood and more.

Imported Item Descriptions.perk_nightshaderecycler: A personal recycler bound to your will. Because walking to Outpost is for people with patience — and we don’t do that here. 2 per wipe. Place responsibly
Imported Item Descriptions.casino_cardtable: Ante up. Bluff hard. Lose everything. A proper Nightshade evening starts with bad bets and worse decisions.
Imported Item Descriptions.casino_slotmachine: Pull the lever and let fate decide. Warning: the machine feeds on hope and pays out in disappointment.
Imported Item Descriptions.vipperk_supercard: Think: 5th Element Multi-Pass, but for puzzle rooms
Imported Item Descriptions.perk_supercard: Think: 5th Element Multi-Pass, but for puzzle rooms
Imported Item Descriptions.helisignal_easy: A light tap on Karen’s shoulder. Single patrol heli with manageable pressure. Recommended: Solo / Duo. Good warm-up… or confidence boost.
Imported Item Descriptions.helisignal_medium: Karen heard you. Increased aggression and damage output. Recommended: Solo / Duo. Bring meds and don’t stand still.
Imported Item Descriptions.helisignal_hard: Karen is now actively upset. Sustained fire, heavier damage, and less room for mistakes. Recommended: Duo / Small Team. Cover matters.
Imported Item Descriptions.helisignal_elite: Karen filed a complaint. High pressure, aggressive targeting, and serious damage output. Recommended: Small Team (2–3). You will feel this one.
Imported Item Descriptions.multiheli_easy: You called Karen… and her friend. Two helis, light coordination. Recommended: Duo. Manageable, but don’t get sloppy.
Imported Item Descriptions.multiheli_medium: Karen brought backup. Dual heli pressure with overlapping fire. Recommended: Duo / Small Team. Positioning starts to matter.
Imported Item Descriptions.multiheli_hard: Karen formed a committee. Constant pressure from multiple angles. Recommended: Small Team (2–4). Expect chaos.
Imported Item Descriptions.multiheli_elite: Karen escalated this to management. Multiple helis, relentless fire, and zero breathing room. Recommended: Full Team (3–5). Good luck.
Imported Item Descriptions.heliwave_normal: They just keep coming. Sequential heli waves increasing in difficulty. Recommended: Full Team (3–5). Ammo check before you start.
Imported Item Descriptions.heliwave_hard: This is a mistake. Continuous waves, escalating chaos, and no real downtime. Recommended: Full Team (4–6+). Bring everything. Lose nothing.
Imported Item Descriptions.dungeon_easy: A gentle introduction into the unknown. Light resistance and modest rewards. Recommended: Solo / Duo. Great for testing builds, aim, or bad decisions with minimal consequences.
Imported Item Descriptions.dungeon_normal: Things start to bite back. Expect smarter enemies and more pressure. Recommended: Solo / Duo. Bring meds—you’ll actually use them now.
Imported Item Descriptions.dungeon_medium: You’re no longer the main character here. Stronger enemies and tighter fights. Recommended: Duo / Small Team. Solo possible… but bold of you.
Imported Item Descriptions.dungeon_hard: Aggressive AI and real pressure. Mistakes get punished fast. Recommended: Small Team (2–3). Bring ammo, meds, and at least one competent friend.
Imported Item Descriptions.dungeon_nightmare: This dungeon does not like you. Chaos, high-tier enemies, and relentless pressure. Recommended: Full Team (3–5). Solo not recommended unless you enjoy suffering.
Imported Item Descriptions.dungeon_impossible: This was a bad idea. Overwhelming difficulty, nonstop aggression, zero forgiveness. Recommended: Full Team (4–6+). Communication required. Survival optional.
Imported Item Descriptions.VIP_Market: The fancy gremlin counter. VIP-only goodies, questionable perks, and just enough privilege to make the loot goblins jealous.
Imported Item Descriptions.bradsignal_easy: Summons an Easy Bradley encounter. Recommended: 1 player. Baby’s first tank tantrum. Still has bullets, still has feelings, still very much would like you deleted.
Imported Item Descriptions.bradsignal_medium: Summons a Medium Bradley encounter. Recommended: 1–2 players. For when Easy was too polite and you’re ready for the tank to develop a personality disorder.
Imported Item Descriptions.bradsignal_hard: Summons a Hard Bradley encounter. Recommended: 2–3 players. This is where the tank stops being a loot piñata and starts being your therapist’s next invoice.
Imported Item Descriptions.bradsignal_elite: Summons an Elite Bradley encounter. Recommended: 3–4 players. Expensive, angry, and built like it knows you have meds on your hotbar.
Imported Item Descriptions.bradsignal_expert: Summons an Expert Bradley encounter. Recommended: 4–5 players. The tank has studied your habits, judged your base design, and chosen violence professionally.
Imported Item Descriptions.bradsignal_nightmare: Summons a Nightmare Bradley encounter. Recommended: 5+ players. Not recommended for the fragile, the sleepy, or anyone emotionally attached to their inventory.
Imported Item Descriptions.bradwave_normal: Starts a Normal Bradley wave event. Recommended: 3–4 players. One tank was apparently not enough, so now we’re ordering armored problems in bulk.
Imported Item Descriptions.bradwave_hard: Starts a Hard Bradley wave event. Recommended: 5+ players. Multiple tanks, fewer life choices, and a very real chance your team comms become farm animal noises.
Imported Item Descriptions.helisignal_expert: Summons an Expert Patrol Heli. It arrives loud, rude, and fully prepared to turn your confidence into a smoking crater.
Imported Item Descriptions.helisignal_nightmare: Summons a Nightmare Patrol Heli. This is not a fight. This is an airborne HR complaint with rockets.
Imported Item Descriptions.multiheli_expert: Summons multiple Expert helis. Because apparently one flying war blender was not enough seasoning for your evening.
Imported Item Descriptions.multiheli_nightmare: Summons multiple Nightmare helis. Congratulations, you have purchased sky-based emotional damage with a side of rotor noises.
Imported Item Descriptions.adv_large_planter_t1: A reinforced large planter infused with early-stage enhancements. Operates at 80% optimal conditions with no water or light required, offering a reliable and low-maintenance farming upgrade.
Imported Item Descriptions.adv_large_planter_t2: A refined large planter engineered for efficiency. Operates at 100% optimal conditions with no water or light required, and crops remain ripe without decaying—perfect for consistent, hands-off farming.
Imported Item Descriptions.adv_large_planter_t3: A high-tier agricultural planter designed for maximum performance. Operates at 150% optimal conditions with no water or light required, and crops never decay when ripe—ideal for large-scale, high-output farming.
Imported Item Descriptions.adv_small_planter_t1: A compact planter upgraded with basic enhancements. Operates at 80% optimal conditions with no water or light required, making it ideal for simple, low-maintenance setups.
Imported Item Descriptions.adv_small_planter_t2: An optimized small planter built for reliable harvests. Operates at 100% optimal conditions with no water or light required, and crops remain ripe without decaying—perfect for efficient micro-farming.
Imported Item Descriptions.adv_small_planter_t3: A precision-engineered small planter built for peak efficiency. Operates at 150% optimal conditions with no water or light required, and crops never decay when ripe—enabling powerful, fully automated farming setups.
Imported Item Descriptions.Animal_Pen: A cozy little livestock jail for your future nuggets, bacon seeds, and questionable farming ambitions. Place it, feed the chaos, pretend this was a survival game plan.
Imported Item Descriptions.pump_jack: Virtual Quarry Only - oil goblin. Slap this in and let it scream crude oil out of the earth like the map owes you child support.
Imported Item Descriptions.mining_quarry: Virtual Quarry Only - Rock muncher. Fuel it, and watch it chew the planet into resources while you do literally anything else.
Imported Item Descriptions.survey_charge: For Virtual Quarries only. Toss this spicy dirt-sniffer to locate virtual quarry deposits for /VQ. Do not use for in world placeables
Imported Item Descriptions.quarry_static_pumpjack: This is the physical oil machine you place in the world. (Player Placeable and removeable)
Imported Item Descriptions.quarry_static_mining: This is the chunky real-world rock vacuum you place on the map. (Player Placeable and removeable)
Imported Item Descriptions.vipperk_iron_axe: VIP perk iron axe. For when trees looked at you funny and now must be processed into emotionally unavailable lumber.
Imported Item Descriptions.vipperk_iron_pickaxe: VIP perk iron pickaxe. Not fancy. Not subtle. Just a reliable little rock bonker for people with places to be and nodes to disrespect.
Imported Item Descriptions.vipperk_axe: VIP perk axe. Sharper, meaner, and legally distinct from anger management. Trees hate this one weird trick.
Imported Item Descriptions.vipperk_salvaged_pickaxe: VIP perk salvaged pickaxe. For players who want their mining tool to look like it survived three divorces and a Bradley encounter.
Imported Item Descriptions.large_backpack: More pockets for your pocket problem. Carry extra loot, extra snacks, and the emotional burden of refusing to depot.
Imported Item Descriptions.super_tea: Liquid productivity with suspicious side effects. Chug it and become the kind of person nodes warn each other about.
Imported Item Descriptions.test_generator: Forbidden hum box. Produces power, bad decisions, and the vibe of someone who absolutely bypassed the intended tech tree.
Imported Item Descriptions.mlrs_truck: Mobile war crime-adjacent driveway decoration. Place it carefully, aim responsibly, and remember: consequences are just content with extra steps. (Player Placeable)
Imported Item Descriptions.door_closer: For people who were raised in a barn but are now trying to heal. Automatically shuts doors before the base becomes a loot piñata.
Imported Item Descriptions.hobo_barrel: A warm little barrel of questionable comfort. Perfect for mood lighting, frostbite prevention, and looking like you lost an argument with capitalism.
Imported Item Descriptions.plush_scientist: Tiny scientist. Zero threat. Maximum judgment. Place him somewhere important so he can silently disapprove of your base layout.
Imported Item Descriptions.plush_hazmat: Soft little hazmat buddy. Immune to radiation, vulnerable to being placed in cursed corners for decoration crimes.
Imported Item Descriptions.plush_charity_01: A plushie with a cause and absolutely no survival instincts. Protect them or face the moral consequences, you monster.
Imported Item Descriptions.plush_pookie_bear: Pookie bear has seen your search history, your loot room, and your wiring. Pookie remains disappointed but supportive.
Imported Item Descriptions.plush_charity_02: Another adorable charity plushie. Adds cuteness, reduces emotional stability, and makes your base look slightly less like a bunker full of feral raccoons.
Imported Item Descriptions.deployable_rustige_egg_a: Rustige Egg A. Decorative egg of mystery. Does it do anything? Emotionally, yes. Mechanically, probably not. Still adorable.
Imported Item Descriptions.deployable_rustige_egg_b: A festive little egg for players who looked at survival horror and said, but what if it was seasonal?
Imported Item Descriptions.deployable_rustige_egg_c: Place it proudly. Confuse your enemies. Concern your teammates. Interior design is warfare.
Imported Item Descriptions.deployable_rustige_egg_d: Egg-shaped proof that your base has entered its whimsical nonsense era.
Imported Item Descriptions.deployable_rustige_egg_e: Not edible, not tactical, still somehow necessary. The loot goblin demands decor.
Imported Item Descriptions.deployable_rustige_egg_f: A tiny seasonal object with huge divorced-craft-store energy. Perfect. No notes.
Imported Item Descriptions.deployable_rustige_egg_g: For when your compound needs less menace and more suspicious holiday cheer.
Imported Item Descriptions.deployable_rustige_egg_h: The final egg in the emotional support egg lineup. Collect them all and become ungovernable.
Imported Item Descriptions.fuel_diesel: Industrial soup for big machines. Feed it to quarries, pumpjacks, and other metal demons that refuse to run on hopes and vibes.
Imported Item Descriptions.tool_jackhammer: The node deleter. Point at rock, hold button, receive dopamine. Side effects include tunnel vision and forgetting you came outside for wood.
Imported Item Descriptions.tool_chainsaw: Tree violence with a pull cord. Bring low grade, bring confidence, and maybe apologize to the forest after.
Imported Item Descriptions.tool_ladder: A vertical problem solver. For climbing walls, making choices, and discovering exactly how confident your enemies were in their base design.
Imported Item Descriptions.carmods_chassis_2mod: A tiny gremlin wagon starter kit. Two module slots, four wheels, and just enough dignity to get you home before someone judges your parking.
Imported Item Descriptions.carmods_chassis_3mod: The reasonable adult choice, unfortunately. Three module slots for when you need storage, speed, chaos, or all three because planning is for people with sleep schedules.
Imported Item Descriptions.carmods_chassis_4mod: The full land yacht experience. Four module slots of mobile bad decisions, perfect for road trips, loot hauling, and becoming a loud problem on purpose.
